description: Narrow capability for zoom windows, which show an image file's two versions, a pull request's among them (diff-view: Image Comparison, Zooming). Their labels are derived from the file they show (see crates/specforge/src/image_window.rs), so they are matched by glob. It grants exactly what the window uses: closing itself on Escape, Cmd/Ctrl-W or its close control, and the two image reads its root chooses between — a commit's and a pull request's. It listens for nothing, opens no other window and reads no document, and it gets none of the dialog, autostart, notification, menu or tray permissions (pull-request-actions: Application Commands Are Granted Per Window Kind).
